english.title: Attempt to rescue goods seized in execution under process of a County Court
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) attempted to rescue goods, namely **(..SPECIFY GOODS..), seized in execution under process of the county court at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION OF THE COUNTY COURT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 92(1) of the County Courts Act 1984.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
attempted to rescue goods seized
in execution under process of a County Court

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The judge may at any time revoke an order committing a person to prison under this section and, if he is already in custody, order his discharge.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant attempted to rescue goods, namely **(..SPECIFY GOODS..), seized in execution under process of the county court at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION OF THE COUNTY COURT..).
